question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The elaborate syllabi had to be ________(summarised) to make a presentation in the UGC assessment meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"summarised"** means to give a brief statement of the main points of something. (सारांशित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She **summarised** the long report in just a few sentences.
 
 
 
• **"Recapitulated" **means to restate or briefly repeat the main points of something. (पुनः सारांश प्रस्तुत करना)
 
 
• **Example: **At the end of the lecture, the professor** recapitulated **the key concepts.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'summarised' **is **'recapitulated'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expanded **(विस्तारित): To increase in size, range, or amount.

 
 
• **Example:** The company expanded its operations to new markets.
 
 
 
• **Prolonged **(लम्बा खींचा हुआ): To extend the duration of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The meeting was prolonged due to extensive discussions.
 
 
 
• **Lengthened** (लंबा किया हुआ): To make something longer.
 
 
• **Example:** The tailor lengthened the hem of the dress.
